deterministic_authority.behavior: Actual DomainService and temporary SQLite; fixed fictional actors and proposals; no live transport or physical handover.

limits: Fictional corpus and bounded predeclared regex/fact probes; unmapped paraphrases are retained, not automatically called hallucinations.
No universal semantic-accuracy, ownership-accuracy, campus-adoption or physical-return claim.
Live model proposals are separate from deterministic action authority; this evaluation does not operate Switch.
First results must be preserved; prompt/scorer fixes after held-out exposure require a new evaluation version.
